nodes.label: Mobile Mentorship Expansion Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step plan to extend the mobile app with Mentor/Mentee modules, six Laravel API controllers, and IndexedDB v5 offline stores.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Version 5
nodes.rationale: Adds mentorships, participants, myClasses, trainings, and attendance stores to existing mnch_offline database.

nodes.label: MentorshipController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller listing mentorships where the authenticated user is lead mentor or accepted co-mentor.

nodes.label: ClassModuleController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for module lifecycle: list, start, complete, sessions. Delegates to ClassModule model methods.

nodes.label: AttendanceApiController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for mentor attendance roster and manual/bulk marking via AttendanceService.

nodes.label: MenteeApiController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for mentee class list, detail, and self-confirm attendance via AttendanceService.

nodes.label: ParticipantController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller returning class participants and per-mentee module progress.

nodes.label: GlobalTrainingController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for MOH/national trainings list, detail, and participants.
